question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?
101 105 114 130 155 ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the difference between consecutive terms:

105 − 101 = 4 = 2²

114 − 105 = 9 = 3²

130 − 114 = 16 = 4²

155 − 130 = 25 = 5²

Next difference = 6² = 36 ⇒ 155 + 36 = 191

**∴ The correct answer is 191.**
